Rewrite 23 as the sum of 20 and 3, then apply the distributive property \(a \times (b+c) = a \times b + a \times c\):
\[
\begin{align*}
17 \times 23 &= 17 \times (20 + 3) \\
&= (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3) \\
&= 340 + 51 \\
&= 391
\end{align*}

17 \times 23 &= (20 - 3)(20 + 3) \\
&= 20^2 - 3^2 \\
&= 400 - 9 \\
&= 391
\end{align*}
